Apple, McDonald's, Meta and Vital Cannabis round out our Top 5

Here’s our run-down of the week’s top work, chosen by the Clios staff.

Best: Arnold Schwarzenegger Pumps Up Xmas in a Santa Suit for Amazon

Arnie muscles his way through a holiday romp as Kris Kringle, sampling the season’s simple pleasures in NYC. “Lifting’s kind of my thing,” he quips in one sequence, tossing a pine tree javelin-style onto the top of a car. From Hungryman director Wayne McClammy and Amazon’s in-house team. Read More

2. McDonald’s Brings Macaulay Culkin Home for the Holidays

He’s a few miles from home, actually. But definitely still alone. Like Ahhhnold above, this marks another triumph of nostalgic celeb casting. M.C. cuts up as Kevin McCallister in a Mickey D’s on a snowy night after closing time. From Wieden+Kennedy Toronto and directors Ramy Youssef and Amir Farhang. Read More

3. For the Holidays, Apple Helps Make an Artist’s Dream Come True

TBWA\MAL and director Melina Matsoukas present a memorable tear-jerker about a young artist who gets a very special gift. (It’s a Mac. D’uh.) Paintings and sculptures by Hebru Brantley add a bright, bold dimension. Read More

4. Meta Dramatically Reframes the Holidays and Its AI Glasses in ‘Window Shopping’

There’s gorgeous craft on display from Mother L.A. and director Max Siedentopf of Division. It’s old-timey but high-tech too, celebrating the joys of brick-and-mortar shopping in our age of digital wonders and online overload. Read More

5. ‘Nug on the Rug’ Spreads Cheer. So Be Nice, Not Naughty

Heads up, it’s the holidays. (Heh.) Bandits & Friends rolls the perfect tone for Vivid Cannabis, with a budding Xmas character guaranteed to go up in smoke. Read More

David Gianatasio is managing editor at Clio Awards.
